enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Remain still. Breathe deeply. Turn onto back. Pull blanket down slightly.
Sit up on bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wipe face with towel. Turn off tap. Turn off light.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk and eggs. Crack eggs into bowl. Cook eggs in pan. Transfer to plate. Sit at table. Eat breakfast. Drink milk. Stand up. Walk to sink with plate. Rinse plate.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt, pants, socks, shoes. Close wardrobe. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Pick up bag. Walk out of bedroom.

Walk to bus stop. Stand at bus stop. Check phone. Put phone in pocket. Bus arrives. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk to hospital. Enter hospital. Walk to locker room. Change into scrubs. Walk to ward.

Walk to nurse station. Pick up patient chart. Review notes. Walk to patient room 1. Greet patient: 'Good morning, how are you feeling?' Check vitals. Adjust IV drip. Walk to patient room 2. Administer medication. Walk to patient room 3. Change dressing. Talk to doctor. Walk to supply room. Restock supplies. Walk to nurse station. Update records.

Walk to cafeteria. Pick up tray. Choose food. Pay for food. Find table. Sit down. Eat lunch. Drink water. Talk to colleague: 'How's your day?' Check phone. Finish eating. Stand up. Return tray. Walk to restroom. Wash hands. Walk back to ward.

Walk to patient room 4. Check monitor. Adjust settings. Walk to patient room 5. Assist with mobility. Walk to nurse station. Answer phone. Take message. Walk to patient room 6. Draw blood. Label sample. Walk to lab. Deliver sample. Walk to nurse station. Update records. Talk to family.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk home. Enter home. Remove shoes. Walk to bedroom. Change into casual clothes. Walk to living room.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Close refrigerator. Take out cutting board and knife. Chop vegetables. Cut meat. Turn on stove. Pour oil into pan. Add meat. Stir. Add vegetables. Stir. Add sauce. Turn off stove. Transfer to plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Stand up. Walk to sink with plate. Rinse plate.

Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Put phone down. Get up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out snack. Close refrigerator. Walk back to living room. Sit on sofa. Eat snack. Watch TV. Pick up remote. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk to bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Rinse face. Dry face with towel. Turn off tap. Turn off light.
Lie down on bed. Pull blanket. Close eyes. Breathe. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Stretch. Remain still. Breathe deeply. Turn onto back. Pull blanket up.
